## What problem does this solve

What's the gap or pain point you're hitting? Concrete example helps more than abstract framing.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. Sketches, pseudo-code, or example outputs all welcome.

## Alternatives considered

If you thought about other approaches, mention them and why you'd pick this one.

## Scope

Roughly how big is this change? A new theme is small; a new clue type touches six files; a web UI is its own subproject. Helps decide whether this needs design discussion before someone starts coding.
